epistemic_purpose: determine whether a background-terminal event must resume outstanding agent work, then repair only the proven re-entry seam

product_contract.doctrine_evidence: sdk/packages/core/src/extensions/tools/definitions.ts:675: 'For long-running commands, run them in background and redirect output to a tmp file that you can read from later.'
product_contract.doctrine_summary: F4 places background-output management on the MODEL (tmp-file convention). It does not categorically forbid the runtime from adding notify-on-terminal; it does not categorically require it either. The runtime's structural choice (no notify-on-terminal) is not a doctrinal mandate; it is the canonical ClineMM contract.

reproduction.red_note: The AGCONT01 7-test family proves (a) the BTCONT01 terminal->turn-state bridge fires exactly once under the four conservation rules, and (b) an unconnected sentinel wasn't called. The LOAD-BEARING argument for 'no automatic agent re-entry exists' is structural (see 30-structural-no-invocation-recon.md and 04-recon.txt F1), not the unconnected spy.

causality.ablation_note: AC1 and AC2 ablations are not applicable because the AC3 classification does not require a runtime re-entry obligation. The F4 doctrine places the polling/output-management obligation on the model, not the runtime. The runtime correctly honors the model's done event as end-of-turn.

repair.rationale: Per ACT section 50 stop rule. The structural recon (30-structural-no-invocation-recon.md) confirms NO production terminal->AgentRuntime consumer exists in ClineMM's run_commands path. The runtime's behavior is correct as a structural choice. Adding any 'terminal wakes model' mechanism would be a product-surface change, not a runtime defect repair.

live_qualification.rationale: AC3 classification: the runtime does not promise automatic agent re-entry. No live qualification is needed.

doctrine_bound.f4_text: For long-running commands, run them in background and redirect output to a tmp file that you can read from later.
doctrine_bound.implication_for_user_request: F4 tells the MODEL how to handle background command output (tmp-file convention). It does not specify runtime obligations for the user's 'wait until finished' intent. The runtime's structural choice (no automatic re-entry) is canonical but not doctrinally mandated.
doctrine_bound.product_surface_open_question: Whether ClineMM should adopt an opt-in notify-on-terminal pattern (e.g. a per-tool flag matching the upstream background-terminal example plugin) is a PRODUCT question, not a runtime defect. Out of scope for AGCONT01.
